$comment: Biddy animation manifest. Maps each (creature × activity) context to a weighted list of animation files. The app's weighted-random selector reads this to pick which animation to play. v1 ships only cat-laptop with 5 real files; the remaining 7 slots are placeholders (copy a real file and rename it, replace later). Weights need not sum to 100 — the selector normalizes them.

defaults.$comment: Default weighting template applied to any context unless overridden. Slot 00 (main) is heavily weighted; the 11 variations split the remainder.

contexts.$futureContexts: Replicate the cat-laptop block for every creature × activity. Creatures: cat, robot, blob, plant, fox, owl. Activities: computer, reading, knitting, cleaning. Naming: {creature}-{activity}-main.svg and {creature}-{activity}-var-NN.svg. 6 creatures × 4 activities × 12 slots = 288 files total at full vision.
